## Description

WCAG 2.2 AA audit (automated + manual screen reader, keyboard, 200 % zoom, RTL) of staff app and portal; load test at 5× pilot volume per country with target latencies.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** No open WCAG AA blockers on core journeys.
- [ ] **AC2.** Under 5× pilot load: reads p95 < 300 ms, writes < 600 ms, page interactive < 2.5 s p75.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
